snippet.title: Syberia Remastered – Before/After
snippet.description:
The wait is almost over! Syberia Remastered launches November 6, 2025!

After more than two decades, Kate Walker's extraordinary journey returns with breathtaking visuals that honor Benoît Sokal's timeless masterpiece.

🖤 Wishlist Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3660220/Syberia__Remastered/

💙 Wishlist PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/fr-fr/concept/10015158/

💚 Wishlist Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/syberia-remastered/9P7NXKCS6XBR

What's new:
- Completely reimagined graphics & animations
- Modernized interface while preserving the original's soul
- Available on PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC
- Limited physical edition for collectors

The side-by-side trailer showcast the transformation from 2002 to 2025.

And for VR enthusiasts: Syberia VR drops November 13 on Quest 3! 🥽

Ready to embark on this unforgettable adventure once again?
